source_policy.markdown: All Markdown files were read in full. SHA-256-identical copies were logically covered by one directly read representative, with every mirror path retained below.
source_policy.non_markdown: Only path, name/extension (derivable from relative_path), size, modified time, and SHA-256 were inspected; contents were not interpreted or executed.

evidence_refs.locator: recursive directory and file enumeration captured in $.entries
evidence_refs.supports: The manifest records every observed upstream directory and file with stable relative paths and mechanical metadata.
Directory/file counts, the protected-tree digest, Markdown deduplication coverage, and three-tree equality are mechanically derived from the recorded paths and SHA-256 values.
Each Markdown read path and each non-Markdown metadata-only path is explicitly distinguished.
